blind.summary: This builds B09 HUD event motion. On a position change the Pos panel bumps (scale 1.12, stamp 160 ms) and its digit rolls up inside a clip-path box (snap 120 ms). On a new lap the Lap panel stamps from scale 1.18 with the 6px shadow landing to 3px. Both are cleared in sim time, 10 ticks after the event, and an `is-again` copy of the keyframes restarts a move that is still playing. The race entry starts from reset() through a single enter() function and ends at GO. The top panels slide down and the touch slots slide up, with 40 ms stagger delays from 0 to 0.32s. Everything sits inside prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference, so the press sink is kept. Touch zones are re-measured while the slots are moving. The stage and Chromium tests cover AC1–AC7, including the no-preference control the plan audit asked for, plus restart, window, direction and second-race cases. All gates are green. Screenshots at 844×390 and 1440×900 show the HUD and controls laid out correctly with no overlap, and matching the S1/S2 mockup. Small issues: the bump scale is a literal instead of the bumpScale token, two happy-dom tests check internal class names, and the change is somewhat larger than the expected file list.
